svg.title: FLOW change paths
svg.desc: How a change reaches a running FLOW app: A, the owner to every device; B, a person to everyone only if the owner signs; C, a person to their own devices; D, a person to one device with no backend; E, device to device with no backend. A and D are built; B and C are designed; E is partly built.
svg.text: Who may change a running app
Every change is signed. The backend carries it but can't sign it. The device checks it before it runs.

g.text: The company signs a release under its keyring. Each host checks the signatures and swaps the
A person to everyone, only if the owner signs
Ana's function reaches every device once the company signs it. The backend can carry it but
A person to their own devices
Ana's function follows her to her phone and tablet through the backend. Ben still has the
A person to one device, no backend
Ana signs a function on her phone. The host checks it against the open directions and runs
it in 7.5 ms. The company's code doesn't restart.
A signed bundle passes between devices by QR code, light or local network and is checked
exactly as if it came online.

svg.text: Built paths are measured in a run of the reference app on the real host (npm run figures). Designed paths are specified, not built.
